avoid_supplements.name: St. John's Wort
avoid_supplements.mechanism: Strong CYP3A4 inducer reduces osimertinib plasma concentrations significantly, decreasing therapeutic efficacy
avoid_supplements.action: Avoid completely; use alternative mood support if needed

avoid_supplements.name: High-dose Vitamin E (>400 IU/day)
avoid_supplements.mechanism: May potentiate bleeding risk and increase cardiovascular events in cancer patients; additive anticoagulant effects
avoid_supplements.action: Restrict to <400 IU/day; monitor for bleeding signs

avoid_supplements.name: Ginkgo biloba
avoid_supplements.mechanism: CYP3A4 induction potential and antiplatelet properties increase bleeding risk with TKI-induced thrombocytopenia
avoid_supplements.action: Discontinue before starting osimertinib; use alternative cognitive support if needed

caution_supplements.name: Garlic supplements
caution_supplements.mechanism: Mild CYP3A4 induction may slightly reduce osimertinib levels; antiplatelet properties add minor bleeding risk
caution_supplements.action: Use in moderation; monitor for efficacy changes

caution_supplements.name: Milk thistle (Silymarin)
caution_supplements.mechanism: CYP3A4 inhibition potential may increase osimertinib exposure; generally well-tolerated at therapeutic doses
caution_supplements.action: Monitor for increased adverse effects; adjust if GI symptoms worsen

caution_supplements.name: Probiotics
caution_supplements.mechanism: May alter gut microbiota affecting osimertinib absorption; generally safe but individual variation exists
caution_supplements.action: Can use; monitor GI tolerance and treatment response

avoid_foods.name: Grapefruit/Grapefruit juice
avoid_foods.mechanism: CYP3A4 inhibition significantly increases osimertinib plasma concentrations, raising toxicity risk
avoid_foods.action: Completely avoid grapefruit and juice; consider alternatives like orange juice

caution_foods.name: High-fat meals
caution_foods.mechanism: May increase osimertinib absorption variability; osimertinib can be taken with or without food but consistency improves stability
caution_foods.action: Maintain consistent meal timing relative to dosing; avoid extreme dietary changes

caution_foods.name: Caffeine
caution_foods.mechanism: May increase QT prolongation risk when combined with osimertinib; modest interaction potential
caution_foods.action: Moderate intake; limit to <200mg/day caffeine equivalents

monitoring_notes: Monitor for QT prolongation (especially with electrolyte abnormalities), interstitial lung disease, and skin toxicities. Assess therapeutic drug levels and efficacy if CYP3A4 interactions suspected; baseline and periodic ECG monitoring recommended, particularly if combining with QT-prolonging substances.
